review_candidates.title: Linux & HPC Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role We are looking for a hands-on Linux & HPC Systems Engineer to join our Treatment Planning and Digital Applications department in Haifa. In this role, you will take ownership of the Linux-based High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure that supports our algorithm development activities. You will work across physical Linux servers, GPU compute nodes, workload scheduling, and shared storage, ensuring the environment remains reliable, efficient, and ready to support the team’s evolving needs. This is a practical, infrastructure-focused role for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work, solving problems at their root, and taking responsibility beyond simply keeping things running. You will collaborate closely with algorithm developers and other technical colleagues, helping them make effective use of the computing environment. You will also contribute to Docker-based deployments and support Azure infrastructure, with opportunities to expand into additional DevOps activities. Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical partner to the team: understanding the environment, independently resolving day-to-day infrastructure challenges, and continuously improving the reliability and usability of the systems that support algorithm development. This is a full-time position based mainly on-site at our Haifa office, reporting to the Algorithms Team Lead. Your Responsibilities Take ownership of the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of our on-premises Linux-based HPC environment. Monitor system health and resource utilization across CPU, memory, and disk I/O, identifying and addressing performance or availability issues. Maintain Linux server configurations, apply system updates and kernel patches, and manage user accounts, permissions, and SSH access. Administer shared storage (e.g., NFS, Samba, BeeGFS), covering capacity monitoring, quotas, and backups. Administer SLURM workload manager, including partitions, queues, and fair-share policies, to help ensure effective use of computing resources. Maintain GPU compute nodes, including NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, GPU scheduling, and GPU-enabled containers. Automate recurring administrative tasks and system checks using Bash, Python, or similar scripting tools, and support configuration management using Ansible. Perform hands-on hardware maintenance and troubleshooting, including server installation, component replacement, and coordination with external vendors. Create, maintain, and optimize Docker-based environments and support containerized application deployments. Troubleshoot issues across systems, applications, networking, and infrastructure, working collaboratively with the relevant technical teams. Support the DevOps team with Azure infrastructure and contribute to the introduction and adoption of tools that address evolving infrastructure needs. Maintain clear technical documentation and practical troubleshooting procedures, helping the team operate and support its environment effectively. Contribute, as needed, to CI/CD pipelines, ML workflow support, and backend services. What You Bring A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. At least 2 years of experience in Linux systems administration or DevOps. Strong hands-on experience administering multi-server, physical Linux environments. You understand how to troubleshoot systems beyond the application layer. Experience with network file systems such as NFS or Samba, and a solid understanding of networking fundamentals. Practical experience with Docker and familiarity with configuration management or Infrastructure as Code tools such as Ansible. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or a similar language, with an interest in automating repetitive work and improving operational efficiency. Familiarity with monitoring tools, virtual machines, and physical server hardware. A proactive, methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to investigate problems, identify root causes, and follow through on solutions. A collaborative mindset and the ability to support algorithm developers and researchers with different levels of infrastructure knowledge. The following experience will be an advantage: Administration or support of HPC environments and workload managers such as SLURM. Experience with GPU computing, including NVIDIA drivers and CUDA. Familiarity with parallel file systems such as BeeGFS, Lustre, or similar technologies. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and containerized deployments. Exposure to CI/CD tools such as GitLab or Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, Kubernetes, or MLOps. Experience with Python/Flask or backend services. You do not need to have worked with every technology listed above. We are particularly interested in someone with strong Linux fundamentals, hands-on infrastructure experience, a sense of ownership, and the curiosity to learn and grow into the wider environment. About Novocure Novocure is a company with a powerful mission: to extend the lives of people living with some of the most aggressive forms of cancer. Join a team of passionate, collaborative people who support each other, challenge one another, and innovate together. Here, you’ll connect, grow, and make a real difference. This fusion of disciplines positions us as true pioneers in oncology innovation, leading a new frontier in the treatment of aggressive cancers. BACKGROUND In July 2023, the World Food Programme (WFP) Zambia Country Office commenced a new five-year Country Strategic Plan (CSP) informed by and aligned with national and United Nations priorities and global commitments under the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It embraces the Government's long-term vision of 2030, aligns with key strategic areas of the 8th National Development Plan (NDP8); and contributes to the joint Zambia-United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF). WFP Zambia’s integrated and pragmatic CSP shifts away from unsustainable localized and micro-level interventions to embrace more effective advocacy and engagement with national policies, systems, and programmes to achieve national impact on SDG2. Given the Government’s commitment to budget support for nutrition, social protection, and agriculture, despite the constraints in the country’s fiscal position, WFP’s overarching strategy seeks to enable the government to meet its national priorities with better systems, expertise, and resources for implementation. This means a decisive shift of WFP’s country positioning towards the provision of innovative, sustainable, upstream technical assistance for nationally owned solutions. Advancing the global WFP Strategic Plan (2026-2029), the Country Strategic Plan (CSP) addresses both SDG2 and SDG17 and is structured around three integrated strategic outcomes: (SO1) saving lives in crises; (SO2) reducing future humanitarian needs through resilience building; and (SO3) strengthening national systems and partner capacities. REPORTING AND PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Information Technology (IT) Operations Officer reports to the Deputy Country Director and heads the Technology (TEC) unit, providing strategic, technical, and operational leadership for ICT services across WFP Zambia. The incumbent oversees ICT operations, staff, systems, and resources to ensure reliable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that support programme delivery, business operations, and emergency response requirements. The role advises senior management on ICT priorities, digital transformation, business continuity, and technology-related risks, while ensuring compliance with WFP corporate standards and fostering innovation, partnerships, and continuous service improvement. Supervise, coach, and develop TEC staff, ensuring effective workload management, accountability, and continuous professional development. Advise senior management on ICT strategy, priorities, risks, resource requirements, and technology investments to ensure alignment between business needs, operational objectives, and WFP corporate standards. Develop and implement TEC workplans, service improvement initiatives, and performance monitoring mechanisms to ensure efficient, client-focused service delivery. Plan, coordinate, and oversee ICT infrastructure, telecommunications systems, networks, end-user computing services, and collaboration platforms to ensure reliable and efficient operations. Ensure the availability, security, and performance of ICT services through proactive monitoring, maintenance, incident management, and timely issue resolution. Lead the implementation of WFP ICT governance frameworks, corporate policies, technical standards, and information security requirements, including ICT risk management, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, and incident response. Lead ICT business continuity, disaster recovery, and emergency preparedness planning to ensure the continuity of critical systems and communications capabilities. Manage ICT budgets, assets, licenses, and resource requirements, and oversee procurement planning, technology contracts, service agreements, and vendor performance to ensure efficient and cost-effective service delivery. Lead the management and support of SCOPE, beneficiary management technologies, and other WFP corporate systems, ensuring system availability, user administration, data protection, compliance with corporate standards, and effective support to programme and operational requirements. Establish and maintain effective partnerships with telecommunications providers, government counterparts, UN agencies, NGOs, and other stakeholders, and represent WFP in relevant ICT coordination forums to promote collaboration, interoperability, and knowledge sharing. Promote innovative technologies and digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, collaboration, accountability, and data-driven decision-making. Coordinate ICT support for programme implementation, field operations, and emergency responses, while promoting staff digital literacy, cybersecurity awareness, and effective use of corporate systems and tools. Prepare management reports, analyses, and recommendations on ICT performance, risks, resource utilization, and strategic priorities to support informed decision-making. Perform other related duties as required. Experience: At least 1 year post-graduate professional experience in IT operations and service delivery, with increasing levels of responsibility in a complex organizational or field‑based environment. Experience managing IT and telecommunications services at country office or decentralized‑operation level, ensuring availability, security, and business continuity. Proven experience in supervising IT staff, providing technical leadership, work planning, and acting as an escalation point for operational issues. Experience in planning, budgeting, and deploying IT/TC systems in line with business needs and corporate standards. Hands‑on experience in IT service management and user support, including incident resolution and service improvement, preferably in an ITIL‑aligned environment. Experience supporting IT procurement and vendor management, including technical specifications and monitoring of service performance. Experience compiling and analysing IT operational and cost data to inform decision‑making. Experience supporting system upgrades, infrastructure maintenance, and emergency IT readiness, ideally in humanitarian or high‑pressure contexts. Experience working in multicultural and inter‑agency environments is an asset. Knowledge & Skills: Strong knowledge of IT operations, infrastructure, networks, end‑user computing, and information security. Solid understanding of IT governance, policies, standards, and compliance within an enterprise environment. Working knowledge of IT service management frameworks (e.g. ITIL). Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to implement practical, sustainable solutions. Ability to plan, prioritize, and manage multiple operational demands while ensuring service continuity. Knowledge of IT project, change, and vendor management principles. Strong client‑service orientation with the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to non‑technical stakeholders and senior management. Ability to build staff capacity, promote knowledge sharing, and support digital skills development. Strong interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure and during emergencies. Languages: Fluency (level C) in English. Aufgaben Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Betrieb, die Weiterentwicklung und die Optimierung unserer Server- und Client - Infrastruktur. Dabei stellst du einen stabilen, sicheren und wirtschaftlichen IT-Betrieb im Rahmen von Incident-, Problem- und Change-Prozessen sicher. Ein Teil deiner Tätigkeit liegt im Software- und Patch-Management inkl. der passgenauen Bereitstellung von Sicherheits- und Funktionsupdates. Du implementierst, konfigurierst und betreibst hierfür geeignete Management- und Automatisierungslösungen, beispielsweise Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) und Intune ebenso wie Windows Server und Cluster. Du betreust zentrale Plattformen und Management-Lösungen für Server, Endgeräte, Software, Updates und Konfigurationen. Hierzu gehören insbesondere Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune und Azure Cloud-Funktionen. Dabei entwickelst du geeignete Betriebs- und Automatisierungsansätze kontinuierlich weiter. Du analysierst bestehende Systemlandschaften, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Performance, Stabilität und Sicherheit um. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben automatisierst du mithilfe von Skripten, insbesondere mit PowerShell. Darüber hinaus erstellst und pflegst du technische Dokumentationen, Betriebsanleitungen und Standards. Moderne Cloud-Technologien und hybride Betriebsmodelle beziehst du dabei in deine Arbeit ein. Profil / Anforderungen Du hast ein Studium in Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet abgeschlossen oder bringst vergleichbare praktische, relevante Berufserfahrung mit.
